def _simplify_op_name(self, full_op_name: str) -> str:
    """
    Get simplified name of the op without the preceding namespace, e.g.
    aten::batch_norm -> batch_norm
    """
    p = full_op_name.find("::")
    if p != -1:
        return full_op_name[p + 2:]
    else:
        return full_op_name
